title: [YouPass Collect] - Huntingdon: Now vs Future
prompt: The maps below show Huntingdon as it is now, and how it will change in the future. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The two maps illustrate the current layout of Huntingdon and the planned changes that will be made to the town in the future.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the most significant transformation will be the conversion of the airfield in the northwest into an industrial estate. Additionally, the road infrastructure will be substantially upgraded, with a new roundabout and several new road connections being constructed.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the northern and central parts of Huntingdon, the airfield, which is currently situated in the northwest alongside the A1 road, will be replaced by an industrial estate. Additionally, the existing railway line will be extended to run directly into this new industrial zone. Moving to the central area, a new roundabout will be added at the junction where Brampton Road meets the road leading to the built-up area. From this roundabout, a new road will also be built, connecting directly to the town centre in the east.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the southern part of the town, a new road link will be established, connecting the A1 directly to the A14, which will then lead into the Ring Road. Meanwhile, several features will remain unchanged, including the railway station on Brampton Road, the built-up area containing homes and shops, and the town centre, all of which will stay in their existing locations.
